get.description: Retrieves a complete list of registered users in the system.

put.description: Activates a user account by setting its status to Active.
Deactivates a user account by setting its status to Suspended.

delete.description: Sets user account status to Deleted.

get.description: Retrieves pending self-registration requests requiring admin approval.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional search keyword for pending registrations. Matches full name, email, or School ID.

get.description: Retrieves all registration requests regardless of approval status.

put.description: Approves a pending registration, enabling the user account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required registration record ID, which is the user's School ID.

put.description: Rejects a pending user registration request.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required registration record ID, which is the user's School ID.

post.description: Submits a self-registration request for Student, Faculty (Educator), or Department Head roles.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing self-registration details.

post.description: Authenticates user using School ID and password, establishing an authenticated session cookie.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing school ID and password.

post.description: Resets password for the user matching the provided email address.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing email and new password values.
Required JSON body containing the refresh token value.
Required JSON body containing the account email address.

get.description: Retrieves all active student accounts along with their current syllabus assignment status.
Retrieves all department syllabi, optionally filtered by status (0=Draft, 1=Submitted, 2=Approved, 3=Rejected).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional syllabus status filter. Values: 0 = Draft, 1 = Submitted, 2 = Approved, 3 = Rejected.

post.description: Allows Department Head to insert or create an approved syllabus directly into the department repository.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing syllabus metadata.

post.summary: Upload and insert a syllabus document file
post.description: Allows Department Head to upload a syllabus PDF/DOCX file and insert an approved syllabus directly.

requestBody.description: Upload syllabus file along with metadata

get.description: Retrieves a summary and list of pending syllabus submissions awaiting review by the Department Head.

put.description: Approves a faculty-submitted syllabus and publishes it to department students. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: syllabusId
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier in the department. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

requestBody.description: Optional JSON body. When provided, only remarks is read.

put.description: Rejects a faculty-submitted syllabus with reviewer feedback. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: syllabusId
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier in the department. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing reviewer remarks.

remarks.description: Required reviewer feedback explaining why the syllabus is rejected.
remarks.example: Please revise the course outcomes and assessment mapping.

post.description: Assigns an approved syllabus to a specific student account. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing studentId and syllabusId.

post.description: Assigns an approved syllabus to multiple students simultaneously. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing studentIds and syllabusId.

get.description: Retrieves all syllabus documents created by or assigned to the logged-in faculty member.

post.description: Allows faculty to create or insert a new draft syllabus record.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing syllabus metadata.

post.summary: Upload and insert syllabus document file
post.description: Allows faculty member to upload a syllabus PDF/DOCX document file and create a draft syllabus record.

requestBody.description: Upload syllabus file along with metadata

get.description: Retrieves single syllabus details owned by faculty member. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier owned by the authenticated faculty member. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

put.description: Updates syllabus details for a draft or rejected syllabus. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier owned by the authenticated faculty member. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

requestBody.description: Required JSON body containing only the syllabus metadata fields to update.

delete.description: Deletes a draft or rejected syllabus document. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier owned by the authenticated faculty member. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

post.description: Submits a draft syllabus to Department Head for review. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required syllabus identifier owned by the authenticated faculty member. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

get.description: Searches syllabi accessible to the logged-in user by keyword, course code, or course title.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Optional search keyword for accessible syllabus course code or title.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of syllabus search results. Values less than or equal to 0 are treated as 100.

get.description: Retrieves version history list for a syllabus document. Accepts 5-digit document ID (e.g. 12345) or GUID.

parameters.name: syllabusDocumentId
parameters.description: Required syllabus document identifier. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

syllabusId.description: Required syllabus identifier. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

studentIds.description: Required list of active student School IDs. At least one ID is required.

syllabusId.description: Required syllabus identifier. Accepts the 5-digit document ID or GUID.

courseCode.description: Required course or subject code for the syllabus.

courseTitle.description: Required course or subject title for the syllabus.

academicYear.description: Required academic year. The handler defaults blank values to 2025-2026.

semester.description: Required semester. The handler defaults blank values to First Semester.

instructorId.description: Optional instructor School ID. Defaults to the authenticated user when omitted or blank.

fileName.description: Optional stored/display file name. Defaults to a course-code syllabus file name.

changeSummary.description: Optional change summary. Currently accepted for metadata compatibility.

email.description: Required email address for the password reset request.

schoolId.description: Required school ID used as the account identifier.

firstName.description: Required first name for the account request.

lastName.description: Required last name for the account request.

email.description: Required valid email address. Must be unique.

schoolId.description: Required institutional School ID. Students use 10 digits; faculty and department heads use 5 digits.

role.description: Required requested role. Allowed self-registration roles are DepartmentHead, Educator, and Student.

password.description: Required password, at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, number, and special character.

confirmPassword.description: Required confirmation value. Must match password.

email.description: Required email address for the account whose password will be changed.

newPassword.description: Required new password, at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, number, and special character.

confirmPassword.description: Required confirmation value. Must match newPassword.

remarks.description: Reviewer remarks. Optional for approval; required for rejection.

courseCode.description: Optional new course or subject code. Blank values are ignored.

courseTitle.description: Optional new course or subject title. Blank values are ignored.

academicYear.description: Optional new academic year. Blank values are ignored.

semester.description: Optional new semester. Blank values are ignored.

instructorId.description: Optional new instructor School ID. Blank values are ignored.

fileName.description: Optional new current file name. Blank values are ignored.

changeSummary.description: Optional latest change summary. Blank values are ignored.

file.description: Required syllabus document file uploaded as multipart/form-data. Empty files are rejected.

courseCode.description: Required course or subject code for the uploaded syllabus.

courseTitle.description: Required course or subject title for the uploaded syllabus.

academicYear.description: Optional academic year. Defaults to 2025-2026 when omitted or blank.

semester.description: Optional semester. Defaults to First Semester when omitted or blank.

instructorId.description: Optional instructor School ID. Defaults to the authenticated user when omitted or blank.

changeSummary.description: Optional upload change summary. A default summary is used when omitted or blank.
